steps.title: Invite a real outside developer (not an OpenAgents identity) to the community room
steps.evidence: Requires a real outside developer invitation and a non-OpenAgents Nostr identity.

steps.title: The invited developer joins the community room
steps.evidence: group=community.workroom.v1; member=b2b2b2b2… invited=true; rooms_distinct=true

steps.title: The developer attaches an agent they already run on their own compute
steps.evidence: agent attached with NIP-OA attestation; unattested attach refused; home fingerprint only

steps.title: The relay admits the agent as an attested key
steps.evidence: attested agent admitted; anonymous agent refused

steps.title: Sarah publishes a work unit and the agent quotes it
steps.evidence: unit=unit.journey.tier1.fixture; grant.scope=agentic_coding.fixture.v1; quote=quote.1; sarahFullProfile=false

steps.title: Sarah accepts exactly one quote
steps.evidence: accepted quote.1 only; second accept refused

steps.title: The agent executes locally and returns a result with evidence
steps.evidence: result bound to request, provider key, and fresh nonce; local execution only

steps.title: An independent verifier with a distinct operator checks the result
steps.evidence: self-verify refused; independent verifier with distinct operator accepted

steps.title: Sarah accepts the result, and award and rank events publish
steps.evidence: accepted work award points=10; rank projection total=10 from award stream

steps.title: No payment occurs, and the room copy said so before the work started
steps.evidence: room copy is experience-only; settlement ledger empty; unit payment=none

steps.title: A rejected result produces a typed reason and an appeal
steps.evidence: reasonClass=evidence_incomplete; appealOpen=true on dispute event

steps.title: A revoked member loses room and unit access immediately
steps.evidence: revocation removes room and unit access; agent home fingerprint unchanged

steps.title: A replayed result, a self-verified result, and an expired grant are each refused visibly
steps.evidence: refused=result_replay,self_verification,grant_expired

steps.title: The developer keeps credentials, home, and configuration unchanged throughout
steps.evidence: home fingerprint unchanged; no provider secrets stored; home not mutated

steps.title: Sybil farming is blocked by attested identity and per-operator rate limits
steps.evidence: per-operator rate limit refused excess quote

steps.title: Awards publish on accepted outcomes only, never on volume
steps.evidence: submitted-not-accepted unit produced zero awards

steps.title: Member content enters Sarah context as quoted untrusted data
steps.evidence: member content framed as untrusted quote; authority not widened

steps.title: Work units carry public-safe objectives and pinned refs only
steps.evidence: unit payload is public-safe with pinned refs only

steps.title: Only scorer keys publish rank, and rank recomputes from awards
steps.evidence: non-scorer refused; scorer rank total=10 matches award stream

steps.title: Open the community room pane on an installed Omega candidate
steps.evidence: Requires the Omega community room pane (SARAH-CW-08) on a live install.

steps.title: The outside developer confirms the outcome in their own words
steps.evidence: Requires a public-safe confirmation from the real outside developer.

independentReviewer.executionIdentityNote: Requires a distinct execution identity separate from the producer agent and from the community member under test.

checklist.check: All automated steps are passed or honestly failed
No secret field, nsec, or private path appears in the receipt
Human residual steps are listed and not marked as live proof
Producer agent did not also accept this receipt
Live outside-developer confirmation remains open until a real developer confirms in their own words
Producer and verifier operators are distinct in accepted independent-verification evidence
